input.prompt:
## Objective
Research the exact launch date of PostgreSQL 16 and its single most significant performance improvement.

## Context
The PostgreSQL 16 release is a major version. Find the official release announcement on postgresql.org, cross-reference with independent tech sources, and identify the headline performance feature from the release notes.

## Output contract
Return ONLY this exact format, nothing else:

### PostgreSQL 16 Release Date
[Exact date in DD Month YYYY format]

### Main Performance Improvement
[Concise description of the single most significant performance improvement, 1-2 sentences max]

### SOURCES
- [URL 1 - description]
- [URL 2 - description]
- [URL 3 - description]

## Boundaries
- Do NOT include any preamble, closing remarks, or commentary outside the three sections above.
- Do NOT list multiple performance improvements. Pick the single most significant one.
- Every factual claim must be backed by at least one source URL in the SOURCES section.
- Cross-reference at least 2 independent sources for the release date.

14 September 2023

### Main Performance Improvement
